Technical

Stats

Goblin_Cleric
Goblin Devout are generic goblin NPCs found throughout Act One. They are the clerics of the Goblin Camp, tapping into their belief in the Absolute to draw divine power. While quite weak in a direct fight, their spells help to buff their allies.
